description:
CONTEXT Currently the ~F sigil delegates to Phoenix.LiveView.TagEngine which requires an "assigns" map in scope and transforms @foo → EEx.Engine.fetch_assign!(var!(assigns), :foo). This forces every component to maintain an assigns map, adds boilerplate (assigns = Map.merge(assigns, %{...})), and prevents compile-time variable tracking (needed for auto-memoization in Item 1b). The goal is a new VNodeCompiler that: 1. Transforms @foo → the bare variable foo (lexically bound in the enclosing scope) 2. Produces a VNode IR instead of Phoenix.LiveView.Rendered 3. Removes the "assigns" guard from sigil_f.ex VNODE IR (already defined in lib/filament/vnode.ex): {:text, iodata} {:element, tag_atom, [{attr_name, attr_value}], [children]} {:component, ModuleAlias, %{prop: value}, key_or_nil} {:fragment, [children]} {:keyed_list, [{key, vnode}]} FILES TO CREATE lib/filament/vnode_compiler.ex FILES TO MODIFY lib/filament/sigil_f.ex CURRENT sigil_f.ex (read the actual file for exact content): - Checks: if not Macro.Env.has_var?(__CALLER__, {:assigns, nil}), raises - Calls: Phoenix.LiveView.TagEngine.compile(source, ..., tag_handler: Filament.HTMLEngine) - Returns: a Phoenix.LiveView.Rendered struct TARGET sigil_f.ex: - Remove the assigns guard entirely - Call: Filament.VNodeCompiler.compile(source, __CALLER__) - Return: whatever VNodeCompiler produces (a VNode expression) VNODE COMPILER IMPLEMENTATION Create lib/filament/vnode_compiler.ex implementing compile/2: defmodule Filament.VNodeCompiler do @doc """ Compiles an ~F template string into a VNode IR expression. @foo references are transformed to bare variable references (foo). """ def compile(source, caller) do # Parse the template as HEEx-like XML # Transform @foo → {foo, [], nil} (bare variable AST node) # Recognize → {:component, ComponentModule, props, key} # Recognize
→ {:element, :div, attrs, children} # Text nodes → {:text, "..."} # Return an Elixir AST expression that evaluates to a VNode at runtime end end KEY TRANSFORMATION RULES 1. @foo → bare variable reference In EEx, @foo is an AST node: {{:., [], [EEx.Engine, :fetch_assign!]}, [], [{:var!, ...assigns}, :foo]} In VNodeCompiler, @foo must become: {foo, [], nil} (i.e., quote do: foo with the actual name) This means the template author uses @count but the generated code references count directly. The variable must exist in the lexical scope of the ~F call site. 2. (capitalized tag) → {:component, SomeModule, %{prop: val}, key} - Props become a map literal - key={expr} prop maps to the key argument (not included in the props map) - If no key= prop, key is nil 3.
, etc. → {:element, :div, [{:class, "..."}, ...], [children...]} - Attribute values: string literals stay as strings, {expr} becomes the expr - on_click={fn} and similar event attrs: keep as-is in attrs for now (renderer handles them) 4. Text content → {:text, "content"} or {:text, expr} for interpolated #{expr} 5. For loops / comprehensions: <%= for item <- items do %> ... <% end %> → {:keyed_list, for(item <- items, do: {item.id, })} NOTE: items in a for loop MUST be wrapped in keyed_list. The key must come from a :key= attribute on the child component, or fail compilation with a clear error message. COMPILE-TIME :key ENFORCEMENT If a ~F template contains a component in a for-loop or list context without a key= attribute, raise at compile time: raise CompileError, description: "Component in list context requires key= attribute. Add key={item.id} or similar unique key." This is a compile-time check — not a runtime check. SIGIL_F UPDATE (lib/filament/sigil_f.ex) Read the current file. The change is: 1. Delete: if not Macro.Env.has_var?(__CALLER__, {:assigns, nil}) do ... raise ... end 2. Replace the compile call from TagEngine → VNodeCompiler.compile(source, __CALLER__) HOW TO HANDLE EEx TEMPLATE PARSING The template is HEEx/EEx syntax. Options: a. Use EEx.compile_string/2 with a custom Engine that intercepts handle_assign/1 b. Parse as raw string with a custom tokenizer c. Extend Phoenix.LiveView.HTMLEngine callbacks Recommended approach (a): implement a custom EEx engine that subclasses EEx.Engine, overrides handle_assign/1 to return a bare variable reference instead of fetch_assign!, and accumulates VNode expressions rather than iodata. defmodule Filament.VNodeEngine do @behaviour EEx.Engine # Override handle_assign/1: def handle_assign({:@, meta, [{name, _, atom}]}) when is_atom(atom) do {name, meta, nil} # bare variable reference end # ... other EEx.Engine callbacks that build VNode IR end TESTING Run: mix test All existing tests must pass. Write a test in test/filament/vnode_compiler_test.exs: - A simple template ~F"
hello
" compiles without error and the macro expands to an {:element, :div, ...} expression (use Macro.expand or just assert the runtime result is a vnode tuple) - @count in a template resolves to the lexically-bound variable count (not assigns[:count]) - A component tag compiles to {:component, TodoItem, %{todo: item}, item.id} - A component in a for loop without key= raises CompileError at compile time Also manually verify: in iex -S mix, a component that uses ~F without assigns in scope compiles and renders a VNode.
title: Item 1a: VNodeCompiler — lexical @-variable scoping and sigil_F
